content_item.canCreateContentItem: Allows creating a content item. Found in the Administration Content Item area.
content_item.canDeleteContentItem: Allows deleting a content item. Found in the Administration Content Item area.
content_item.canGetContentItem: Allows viewing a content item. Found in the Administration Content Item area.
content_item.canGetContentItemList: Allows viewing content item list. Found in the Administration Content Item area.
